name: tradefloor
description: A trading desk for any market: analysts, bull/bear debate, trader, risk committee and portfolio manager over deterministic, point-in-time market data. Direction with calibrated probabilities, a sized trade plan, and a journal that scores every call.

default_market.title: Home market
default_market.description: Exchange code for bare tickers (RELIANCE -> RELIANCE.NS for NSE). US, NSE, BSE, LSE, XETRA, EPA, AMS, TSE, HKEX, SSE, SZSE, KRX, TWSE, SGX, ASX, TSX, B3, JSE and more.

default_horizon.title: Default horizon
default_horizon.description: Forecast and holding horizon when none is given.

capital.title: Trading capital
capital.description: Account size in your home currency, for position sizing. 0 skips sizing.

risk_per_trade_pct.title: Risk per trade (%)
risk_per_trade_pct.description: Percent of capital lost if the stop is hit. 0.5 to 1 is a common professional range.

max_position_pct.title: Max position size (%)
max_position_pct.description: Cap on a single position as a percent of capital, whatever the stop distance.

intraday_risk_pct.title: Intraday risk per trade (%)
intraday_risk_pct.description: Percent of capital lost if an intraday stop is hit. Used by /tradefloor:scout.

debate_rounds.title: Bull/bear debate rounds
debate_rounds.description: Rounds in the researcher debate for a standard run. Deep runs add one. Each round is two more agent calls.
